lines.en: mom, hemp, horse, scold
eight, pull, hold, dad
clothes, aunt, chair, meaning
One two three four, tones are fun!
lines.pinyin: Yī èr sān sì, shēngdiào zhēn yǒuqù!

chants.title: 你好，你好
chants.en: Two third tones in a row

lines.en: Hello, hello! (the first 3rd tone rises: ní hǎo)
Very good, very good!
Hello, teacher! Hello to you too!
I'm well, I'm well too!
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hěn hǎo, wǒ yě hěn hǎo!

lines.en: Hello, hello, how are you?
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo nǐ hǎo, nǐ hǎo ma?

lines.en: I'm very well, thank you!
Good morning, good evening.
Bye bye, see you tomorrow!
Monday, Tuesday, learning Chinese.
Wednesday, Thursday, have a listen.
Friday, Saturday, off to play.
Sunday, at home, a long sleep in!
lines.pinyin: Xīngqītiān, zài jiā li, shuì dà jiào!

lines.en: Yesterday I went to the supermarket,
bought fruit and bread,
had a chat with the owner,
and went home singing!
lines.pinyin: chàng zhe gē huí jiā le!

lines.text: 如果我有时间，我就去海边。
lines.en: If I had time, I'd go to the seaside.
lines.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù qù hǎibiān.

lines.text: 如果我会飞，我就飞上天。
lines.en: If I could fly, I'd fly up to the sky.
lines.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ huì fēi, wǒ jiù fēi shàng tiān.

lines.text: 今天我学习，一步一步走，
lines.en: Today I study, one step at a time,
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ xuéxí, yí bù yí bù zǒu,

lines.en: and every word takes me forward!
lines.pinyin: měi ge cí dōu dài wǒ wǎng qián zǒu!

lines.en: Although it's hard, I'm not afraid.
lines.pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì wǒ bú pà.

lines.text: 虽然很累，但是我还在说。
lines.en: Although I'm tired, I keep on talking.
lines.pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ hái zài shuō.

lines.en: As long as I practice a little every day,

lines.text: 总有一天我会说得很好！
lines.en: one day I'll speak really well!
lines.pinyin: zǒng yǒu yì tiān wǒ huì shuō de hěn hǎo!

lines.en: Six six six, you're awesome!
lines.pinyin: Liù liù liù, nǐ tài niú le!

lines.en: Here's a like: the GOAT!
lines.pinyin: Diǎn ge zàn, yǒngyuǎn de shén!

lines.en: At the weekend I lie flat, no overtime,
speaking Chinese makes me super happy!
